context: Tekla Structures 2017, mm, Bengali speech. From about 09:11 the presenter adds component 142 'Two sided end plate' between a column and two beams, then fills its dialog tabs (Picture, Plates, Bolts, Haunch, ...).

pieces.ask: the parts picked (main part, secondary 1, secondary 2) and every profile name visible (column, beams); whether the beams land on the column's flanges or web; the Picture tab: every box including the numbered dimensions 1-5 (which are blank, which hold 2.00); the Plates tab (t, b, h, Pos_No, material, name).

the second Plates tab (t, b, h); the Bolts tab: bolt size, standard, tolerance, thread in material, site/shop, hole type, the vertical bolt group (reference Top/Middle/Bottom, edge distance, number of bolts, spacing) and the horizontal group (reference, edge distance, number, spacing). Read the number-of-bolts boxes carefully.

the Modify press and the result in the model: do the bolts run across the whole column through both flanges, or only through each end plate and flange; the status bar text after Modify; the component symbol's colour; then the Haunch tab: each plate's t, b, h and the creation lists.
the Haunch tab: plates t / b / h, Pos_No, material, name, the chamfer boxes 1-4 and the creation lists; the Modify / Apply / OK presses; the final status bar text and the component symbol's colour.
